name: pendulum-triple-rotary-flex
$comment: Flexible-arm variant of pendulum-triple-rotary: the arm is a FlexibleBeam3D (Arm), a 3 x 50 mm stainless-steel strip on edge, 0.2159 m, 0.257 kg (the rigid arm's mass), clamped-free modes ny = 2, nz = 2, nt = 1, zeta = 0.01. End A on J1.child, end B on J2 through T2 (a pure rotation), gA from W1, the chain composed on from Arm/poseB. Ctrl is the rigid design's RotaryCtrl, unchanged: it excites the arm's first bending mode and never catches the pendulum.

plots.title: Arm tip deflection, horizontal and vertical (m)

options.text: 193e9 Pa is the stainless strip. The rigid gains need about 23x that (`pendulum-triple-rotary-flex`); the low-pass firmware holds from 0.5x up.
